capabilities: render vault tasks as calendar, list, table, Kanban and Gantt views
edit task lines in their source notes from views (drag, click, context menu)
filter, group, sort and search tasks by priority, status, area and dates
project future occurrences of recurring tasks in calendar views
track habits with grids, streaks, dashboards and vacation periods
disambiguation: Despite the calendar-heavy name, it also includes a standalone Habit Tracker module with streaks, routines and dashboards.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; detailed usage docs live in an external user manual and wiki. Planned features include Google Calendar sync.
problem: Obsidian stores tasks as plain checkbox lines but offers no calendar, board or timeline interfaces for managing them across notes.

relations.evidence: fully compatible with the popular Obsidian Tasks plugin

summary: Task management plugin that renders vault tasks in calendar, list, table, Kanban and Gantt views, with drag-to-reschedule and a built-in habit tracker.
